col.title: TITLE
comp.dlss.desc: nvngx_dlss / dlssg / dlssd libraries, distributed through a manifest carrying each version's MD5 and NVIDIA signature state.
comp.dlss.trust: NVIDIA signature and MD5 checked before any write. DLLs posted by third parties in issues are never read.
comp.dlss5bridge.desc: Neural Rendering bridge: brings DLSS 5 to DirectX 11 and Vulkan games. ReShade add-on, no game file replaced.
comp.dlss5bridge.trust: Prism places the bridge only; the neural runtime comes from the RenoDX DLSS 5 package.
comp.dlssenabler.desc: Emulates DLSS-G on any DirectX 12 GPU by rerouting frame generation to FSR 3.1.
comp.dlssenabler.trust: Fallback when OptiScaler doesn't take on a game.
comp.intro: Every source is checked at startup. No version is pinned inside the app.
comp.matrix_note: The game must already ship Streamline DLSS-G. No overlay creates frame generation from nothing.
comp.mfgada.desc: Unlocks Multi Frame Generation on RTX 40. ReShade add-on: the file is placed next to ReShade, the patch runs in memory.
comp.mfgada.trust: No game file is replaced; uninstalling removes a single file.
comp.mfgunlock.desc: MFG multipliers up to ×6 and dynamic mode on RTX 40, through a proxy DLL. RTX 30 support is experimental.
comp.mfgunlock.trust: Original reverse-engineering work, credited by the derived projects.
comp.multipass.desc: Newer fork: neural pass before upscaling, VRAM leaks fixed, more flexible scaling.
comp.multipass.trust: The archive is published with its SHA-256.
comp.oneclick.desc: Single installer for DirectX 11 and 12, with or without native DLSS, RTX 20 to 50.
comp.oneclick.trust: Single MIT binary. Prism downloads and launches it; it does the rest.
comp.optinr.desc: OptiScaler fork adding the Neural Rendering pass to DirectX 12 games.
comp.optinr.trust: Community fork. ReShade isn't needed; the neural runtime must be provided separately.
comp.optiscaler.desc: Replaces a game's upscaler and brings FSR-FG / XeSS-FG to GPUs without hardware DLSS-G (Turing, Ampere).
comp.optiscaler.trust: Official repository. The project publishes no manager app: ignore any third-party "client".
comp.renodx.desc: Per-game HDR mods: rework tone mapping and unlock HDR where the game doesn't offer it. Prism follows the live wiki.
comp.renodx.trust: Add-ons loaded by ReShade. Per-game settings come from the wiki and are undone on removal.
comp.reshade.desc: Post-processing layer and add-on host. Prism always installs the add-on version, needed by RenoDX and MFG Unlock.
comp.reshade.trust: Downloaded from reshade.me, the project's only source.
comp.rtx20: Same as RTX 30: native port (sm_75) or FSR 3.1.
comp.rtx30: No hardware DLSS-G. Native port (sm_86) or FSR 3.1 through OptiScaler.
comp.rtx40: Official Frame Generation ×2. RenoDX MFG Unlock or RTX40MFG-Unlock go further.
comp.rtx50: Official Multi Frame Generation ×2 to ×4, handled by the driver.
comp.sm75.desc: Same approach on Turing (RTX 20): kernels recompiled for sm_75. Up to three generated frames.
comp.sm75.trust: Tested on RTX 2060 Max-Q; hardware coverage is thin. Binaries come with SHA-256 hashes, outside GitHub releases.
comp.sm86.desc: Ports NVIDIA's DLSS-G engine to Ampere (RTX 30) by recompiling its kernels for sm_86. Original models kept, ×2 to ×4.
comp.sm86.trust: Not an FSR bridge: NVIDIA's engine, recompiled. No release archive — Prism opens the source page, install stays manual.
comp.stale_tip: No commit for over three months
comp.streamline.desc: Matched set of sl.* components. MFG unlockers need a consistent set: mixing sl.* from different packages breaks injection.
comp.streamline.trust: Authoritative source: NVIDIA's published SDK. Prism extracts the matched set and backs up the game's originals.

dlss5.multipass.desc: Newer fork: neural pass before upscaling, VRAM leaks fixed. Archive published with its SHA-256.

dlss5.only: DLSS 5 only — no upscaler, no frame generation

fg.opti.desc: Intercepts DLSS-G and reroutes it to FSR 3.1 FG or XeSS-FG. Works everywhere, but it isn't NVIDIA's engine: generated frames look different. In-game settings menu.
fg.port.dlssg_hint: The port targets DLSS-G model {0}. Prism can deploy it from the signed catalog.

fg.rtx40.dlssg_hint: An nvngx_dlssg.dll is required, deployable from the DLSS page.
fg.runtime_sel_tip: Game's DLLs or NVIDIA's OTA runtime.
fg.sm75.desc: Same approach on Turing: DLSS-G kernels recompiled for sm_75. Up to three generated frames. Tested on RTX 2060 Max-Q; hardware coverage is thin.
fg.sm86.desc: Ports NVIDIA's DLSS-G engine to Ampere by recompiling its kernels for sm_86. Not an FSR bridge: original models kept. ×2 to ×4, as a proxy DLL with dlssg_sm86.ini.
